alloy.preparation: Fe–20%Cr–20%Ni steel; annealed at 1100 °C for 3 h and water quenched. Coupons 7 × 10 × 1 mm ground with 600-grit SiC, polished to 0.25 µm diamond finish, ultrasonically cleaned in acetone then isopropanol, rinsed with double-distilled water and mounted for electrochemistry.

test_solution.preparation: Solutions deaerated with high-purity argon for at least 2 h before analysis; no numerical pH is supplied.

test_method.procedure_description: PAR Model 173 potentiostat with Model 276 interface/352 acquisition; modified Greene cell with Pt counters in separate opposite compartments, separated by porous frits to avoid Pt plating on working electrode. SCE reference. Cathodic pretreatment in 0.1 M HCl at −700 mV SCE for 15 min to remove air-formed oxide; Figure 1 anodic scan at 1 mV/s in 0.1 M HCl + 0.4 M NaCl at 22 °C. The −100 mV/10 min high-Ni passive-film preparation for XPS and MoNi4 nitriding/passivation treatments are separate analyses.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Table 3 explicitly identifies Epit as pitting potential, distinct from passivation Epp and transpassive Etr; no fixed numerical current criterion is supplied.

experiments.result_note: The table explicitly distinguishes Epit from Etr (transpassive potential). The Mo-bearing steels have no numerical Epit cell and are described as having pitting eliminated. Table 1 amounts retain percent notation (basis is not explicitly printed in the table) and the separate S ppm unit. P is strictly <0.003%; no balance or chloride-ion concentration is calculated. Surface/subfilm XPS compositions are not substituted for bulk chemistry.
